newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Telekom slides 1.94 pct in early trading.
newsitem.headline: Telekom slides 1.94 pct in early trading.

text.p: Shares of Telekom Malaysia Bhd added to previous losses in early Friday trading, skidding 1.94 percent on a mix of news and speculation, analysts said.
Around 40 minutes into the opening, the stock was down 40 cents to 20.20 ringgit on volume of 366,000 shares traded.
Analysts said one key factor accounting for the stock's weakness was ongoing shifting of portfolios by fund managers from Telekom into another major utility, power firm Tenaga Nasional Bhd.
"I think a lot of people look at Tenaga as 'the worst is over'. That it's the heavyweight to watch," said Simone Yeo, telecoms analyst at HSBC James Capel.
The ongoing affair on alleged discrepancies in the award of a tender to Sweden's LM Ericsson only affected sentiment towards the stock but not its earnings, analysts said.
